method: Original-only independent manual inspection of two new full-source thumbnails and three unscaled native eye crops. No detector, analysis output, source CV code or primary labels viewed in this stage before freezing.
exposureDisclosure: These two additional photographs were not seen by this annotator before this pass. Earlier work exposed the annotator to other datasets and the product algorithm.
coordinateConvention: Any future labels would be x-right/y-down native crop pixels, with sourceRectNative giving full-photo origin. No coordinates are invented here because reliable sampled upper endpoints were not established.
limits: No labels does not mean no real lashes exist or that a detector should necessarily fail. These are upper-endpoint NOT RESOLVABLE judgments from source inspection, not calibrated ground truth or whole-eye recall measurements. Photo appearance cannot certify bare lashes or makeup history.

views.assessment: Open eye and dark lash line are visible, but fine upper shafts and tips are soft/merged. Forehead hair approaches and crosses the brow/upper-eye region. Large native dimensions do not supply reliably separable distal upper structures in this crop. No endpoint or local tangent label asserted.

Open eye has fine dark upper structures projecting into the eye opening below the upper lid. Shadow, overlap and merged roots prevent confident assignment of individual visible tips with a local axis. Lower lashes are more distinct but are outside the requested upper-lash annotation scope.

Open eye with several fine dark upper hairs over the opening. Upper-lid shadow and overlapping shafts prevent confident endpoint localization; no invented coordinates supplied. Distinct lower-lash detail does not establish upper-lash suitability.

freezePolicy: Initial six-photo labels remain unchanged. Preserve this file after detector exposure; store later disagreements separately.
